subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.

Students were asked to write the historical events in __the order of their occurrence__.
solution:
The correct answer is '**chronological order**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined phrase "**the order of their occurrence**" in the sentence refers to arranging events according to the time at which they happened.
 
• The term that most accurately aligns with this description is "**chronological order**" (कालक्रमानुसार).
 
 
• **Example**: The museum exhibits are arranged in **chronological order** to better represent history.
 
 
 
• "**Chronological order**" denotes the arrangement of events by their time of occurrence from the earliest to the latest.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **chronological order**.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Aesthetic order**: Refers to arrangement based on beauty or art (सौंदर्यात्मक क्रम).
 
• **Historic order**: This isn't a commonly used term in this context. It might imply order based on historical importance but does not specifically denote time sequence. (ऐतिहासिक क्रम)
 
• **Diachronic order**: Pertains to the study or analysis of historical changes across time but is less common and specific than chronological order for indicating the sequence of events based on time. (कालानुक्रमिक क्रम)
